note: One deals list for the whole site. "for" says where a deal shows: locals (the front page strip and /deals/), usa, home (Coming home), es (En español), ukca (UK & Canada). An entry with no "for" counts as locals. A deal needs a real number or a deadline; "until" takes it down the day after. "resort" pulls the from-price from data/staycations-resorts.json, "venue" + "product" pull the visitor price from data/experiences.json, so the cards never go stale.
